name: dsh-agentgit
description: AgentGit collaboration and immutable event history plugin for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/index.jsx --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --outfile=dist/client.js --banner:js="window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: 'dsh-agentgit', factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;" --footer:js="return module.exports; } });"
scripts.lint: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check dist/index.js && node --check dist/client.js
